snippet.title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 7.31.2025
snippet.description:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026! Download the debut demo today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-adventures-of-elliot-the-millennium-tales-debut-demo-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Reveal a mysterious world’s history in a brand-new action-adventure RPG from the creators of OCTOPATH TRAVELER and BRAVELY DEFAULT!

#TheAdventuresOfElliot #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
